actual_scope: One-column flat completion retains every even root-of-unity alphabet for n>=2 and every odd prime-power alphabet for n>=3; arbitrary odd alphabets need at most doubling.
scope_change_reason: The donation asks for an original result rather than another audit. This algebraic side result takes the explicit composite-alphabet boundary in David Ganz's atlas B097; it is not selected-caller formalization.
bottleneck_link: Algebraic side result: removes a prime-only exact phase interface restriction. No supplier, physical cost or kappa gain is claimed.
stop_rule: Stop at the first proved alphabet extension, with bounded exact corroboration; leave odd composite sign exclusion and noise robustness as open questions.
